nome_jp: D2V2 禁断のギガトロン
testo:
Multi
Speed Attacker
Double Breaker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a D2 Field, Initials or Sonic Command, add it to your hand. If you have a D2 Field in the battle zone, you may put it into the battle zone instead.
